description: This file defines a helper class and functions for adjusting string offsets during string modifications, specifically for UTF-8 and UTF-16 conversions with offset adjustments.

classes.name: OffsetAdjuster
classes.description: A helper class for adjusting string offsets in response to string modifications, including nested adjustments and merging adjustments.

methods.name: AdjustOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts multiple offsets based on a series of string adjustments, setting offsets beyond a limit to npos.

methods.name: AdjustOffset
methods.description: Adjusts a single offset based on string adjustments.

methods.name: UnadjustOffsets
methods.description: Reverses offset adjustments to map adjusted string offsets back to original string offsets.

methods.name: MergeSequentialAdjustments
methods.description: Combines two sets of sequential string adjustments into one, maintaining correct offsets relative to the original string.
